title: system
summary: Execute an operating-system command and return status and output text.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: Execute an operating-system command and return status and output text.
behaviors: Executes commands through cmd /C on Windows and sh -c on Unix-like hosts.
Returns status by default; with two requested outputs returns status and combined stdout/stderr text.
When called with zero requested outputs, command output is written to the RunMat console stream.
In WebAssembly builds, returns a nonzero status and an explanatory message because process execution is unavailable.
